tapToSwap: Ukuthepha okukodwa ukuze ushintshe umhlaba wakho noma uhlele imininingwane
ramHighPerf: Ukusetha ngaphambilini kokusebenza okuphezulu - kungase kubangele ukushisa ngokweqile
ramLowPerf: Ukusetha ngaphambilini kokusebenza okuphansi — konga ibhethri
releaseTrain26Body: Uku-game version %s . Sisathuthukisa i-26.x ku-PocketCraft — shintshela ku-1.21.x ukuze uthole ukuzizwisa okungcono.
viewDistanceHint: Amanani aphansi anconyelwe amadivayisi asezingeni eliphansi
maxPowerModeDesc: Isebenzisa i-RAM egcwele kanye nebanga lokunikezela ngobuningi. Kungabangela ukushisa ngokweqile.
mobSpawningDesc: Yehlisa isibalo sebhizinisi ukuze usebenze kangcono
autoRestartDesc: Qala kabusha iseva ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho kuphahlazeka
openFolderDesc: Phequlula amafayela eseva kumphathi wakho wefayela
useAddButton: Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi Engeza ukuze ungenise ifayela, noma ufake elilodwa esikrinini sokuthola.
deleteConfirmDesc: Lokhu kususa ifayela enguqulweni yamanje yeseva.
pluginsTip: Layisha ama-plugin e-Bukkit/Spigot/Paper ahambisanayo .jar. Thola ama-plugin ku-spigotmc.org noma ku-hangar.papermc.io
tapToAddPlugin: Thepha okuthi 'Engeza i-plugin' ukuze ulayishe ifayela le-.jar
noInternetConnection: Alukho uxhumano lwe-inthanethi. Sicela uhlole inethiwekhi yakho.
hubModLoaderDesc: Le nguqulo yeseva ayisebenzisi isilayishi semodi esisekelwayo. Shintshela le seva ku-Fabric noma i-Quilt ukuze ufake amamodi.
hubSectionDownloadedDesc: Lawula lokho osekuvele kugcinwe kule nguqulo yeseva.
hubSectionDiscoverDesc: Imiphumela eku-inthanethi kuphela eboniswa lapha. Okufanayo okufakiwe kumakelwe wena.
hubDeleteDesc: Lokhu kuzolisusa unomphela ifayela kule nguqulo yeseva.
hubSearchRetry: Ukusesha kufakwe kunqolobane futhi kukhawulelwe isilinganiso, ngakho-ke ukuzama futhi ngemva kwesikhashana kuvamise ukusebenza.
hubDetailApplyDesc: Qala kabusha iseva ngemva kokushintsha ama-plugin noma amaphakethe.
worldsStopBeforeReset: Misa iseva ngaphambi kokusetha kabusha umhlaba.
worldsSlotHint: Shelelezisa kwesokunxele ukuze ususe. Imihlaba esebenzayo ingasuswa kuphela uma iseva imisiwe.
worldsImportGuideDesc: Thepha ukuze ubone ukuthi okungeniswayo komhlaba nobukhulu kusebenza kanjani.
worldsResetDesc: Khetha ozokususa. Ama-plugin, mods, config files, and server.properties izogcinwa.
worldsResetPreserved: Ihlala igciniwe: ama-plugin/, mods/, config/, server.properties, namafayela okulungisa.
worldsRestoreDesc:
Lokhu kuzobuyisela: 
 - Imihlaba nedatha yobukhulu 
 - Ama-plugin, ama-mods, namaphekhi wezisetshenziswa 
 - Ukulungiselelwa kweseva nezilungiselelo 
 
 Amafayela akho amanje eseva azocishwa. 
 Qiniseka ukuthi iseva imisiwe ngaphambi kokuyibuyisela.
worldsDeleteWorldActive: Susa i-%s ? I-PocketCraft izoshintshela komunye umhlaba olondoloziwe kuqala.
worldsDeleteWorldInactive: Susa i-%s ? Lokhu kususa umhlaba kusitoreji.
worldsImportGuideText1: Ukuthunyelwa kwe-Aternos kungalayishwa njengama-ZIP angu-3 ahlukene: i-Overworld, i-Nether, kanye ne-The End.
worldsImportGuideText2: Iningi lezinye izipele zomhlaba sezivele zifaka phakathi bonke ubukhulu endaweni eyodwa yomlando, ngakho ukungenisa okuyisipele komhlaba okukodwa kwanele.
filesAddAnotherWorld: Engeza omunye umhlaba ngaphambi kokususa lona.
filesSeedDialogDesc: Faka imbewu yomhlaba wakho. Ishiye ingenalutho emhlabeni ongahleliwe.
filesDeleteWorldDesc: Lokhu kuzosusa unomphela %s futhi kushintshele komunye umhlaba olondoloziwe uma ukhona.
onboardingWelcomeTitle:
Ifoni yakho manje 
 iyiseva ye-game server
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Bamba amaseva e-Java Edition mahhala. 
 Ayikho i-PC edingekayo. Dlala nanoma ubani.
onboardingStep1Body: Iphepha lisebenza endaweni efonini yakho futhi lisebenzisa inkumbulo osuvele unayo.
onboardingStep2Body: I-PocketCraft ikunikeza ikheli elihlukile lokudlulisela abangani abangaxhuma kulo.
onboardingStep3Body: Abadlali be-Java Edition baxhuma ngqo ku-relay ngokungqubuzana okuncane.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Letha umhlaba wakho, ama-plugin, futhi ulungiselele nawe. Akukho ukuqala phansi.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Khipha kusukela e-Aternos, beka ingobo yomlando ku-PocketCraft, futhi uqhubeke.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Phinda usebenzise amafayela afanayo .jar. Isitaki sakho se-plugin sihamba nawe.
onboardingImportConfigBody: server.properties, whitelist, nokufinyelela komsebenzisi kuhlala kunjalo.
onboardingFeaturesTitle: Ukulawula okugcwele, khona kanye ephaketheni lakho
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Akulona uhlelo lokusebenza oluhluliwe. Leli yikhithi yamathuluzi yeseva yangempela.
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: I-PocketCraft isekela ukudlala kwe-Java ne-Bedrock uma ibhuloho livuliwe ekusethweni kweseva yakho.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: Abangane ku-PC kanye neselula bangajoyina umhlaba ofanayo ndawonye ngokusebenzisa i-relay.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Yabelana ngekheli lakho leseva futhi abadlali bangaxhumeka ku-edishini yabo ngokushesha.
onboardingCrossPlayExperimental:
⚠️ Isici Sokuhlola - Dlala Ngokubona Kwakho 
 
 I-cross-play isathuthuka. Iziphazamisi nokuzinza kungase kwenzeke njengoba lesi sici singakasekelwa ngokusemthethweni. Sebenzisa ngokuzifaka wena engozini.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Khetha iseva edluliselwe eseduze nabadlali bakho. Ungakushintsha lokhu kamuva ukusuka kudeshibhodi futhi.
onboardingPermissionsSubtitle: Lokhu kusetshenziselwa isimo seseva, isibalo sabadlali, nezibuyekezo ezibalulekile zangemuva ngenkathi iseva yakho isebenza.
onboardingPermissionsCardBody: Ibonisa isimo seseva nokubalwa kwesidlali ngenkathi iseva isebenza.
onboardingPermissionsStatusWarn: Ukufinyelela kwesaziso kuyadingeka kulesi sinyathelo. Thepha inkinobho engenhla, bese uyivumela ku-Android.
onboardingPermissionsStatusTap: Thepha inkinobho engenhla, bese wamukela imvume ye-Android ukuze uvule Okulandelayo.
onboardingGoogleSubtitle: Ngena ngemvume manje ukuze unike amandla izipele eziyimfihlo ze-Google Drayivu. Ungeqa lokhu futhi uqedele ukusetha kuqala.
onboardingGoogleStatusDesc: Izipele zigcinwa ngaphakathi kwefolda yohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Google Drayivu eyimfihlo. I-PocketCraft ayikwazi ukubona noma ukufinyelela amanye amafayela akho eDrayivu.
onboardingGoogleConnectedDesc: Umhlaba wesiphakeli sakho, ama-plugin, nezilungiselelo kuzogcina ngokuzenzakalelayo kokuthi: %s
onboardingSetupBackupNotice: Ungakwazi ukubuyisela izipele zomhlaba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kokuthi Izilungiselelo noma nini lapho usulungile.
